title: comfy model download --background --json data payload
description: Submit receipt for a backgrounded model download. Resolution (metadata, tokens, filename, destination-exists) already succeeded synchronously; only the byte transfer is detached. Poll with `comfy model download-status <download_id>`.

download_id.description: Opaque id for this download; the key for download-status / download-cancel.

pid.description: PID of the detached worker process.

dest.description: Absolute path the model will be written to.

total_bytes.description: Total size in bytes. Null at submit time — the worker learns it from the response headers.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Always 'starting' in a submit receipt.
